newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint closes firmer versus dollar in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint closes firmer versus dollar in slack trade.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed firmer against the dollar on Monday in featureless inter-bank forex trade.
The forint finished at 152.15/20 against one dollar, compared to an opening level of 152.25/35, following a weakening of the dollar on international markets, dealers said.
The Hungarian currency closed some 10/15 fillers weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level, which stood at 152.08 to the dollar at the close.
